Riley: Heads-up — I saw a wave of 429s from the mobile onboarding flow this morning.
Riley: Happens when users open the app, background it for 30s, then come back — the client replays ~6 queued prefetches.
Riley: Example response headers: X-RI-Quota: 4/60, X-RI-Reset: 72, Retry-After: 3
Dev (mobile-sdk): Which SDKs/versions? Mobile uses native SDK (android v0.9.1, ios v0.9.1). Server-side logs show a retry burst after resume.
Sam (sdk): We already fixed auth-coalesce for server SDKs, but mobile had a different codepath for background resume; it re-triggers auth+prefetch without checking in-progress.
Noor (platform): That replay + low trial quota creates backpressure at the rate limiter. We see many parallel prefetches hit quota then cascade into 401s when refresh races.
Quinn (oncall): Symptoms line up with a double-stampede: expired token triggers refresh attempts from multiple threads, then all retries happen together on resume.
Dev (mobile-sdk): Repro steps: 1) start session, 2) prefetch next 6 pages, 3) background app, system suspends threads, 4) resume -> SDK resumes unfinished requests and also attempts refresh on stale token.
Dev (mobile-sdk): Proposed short-term fixes: - Debounce resume-triggered prefetch (coalesce within 2s), - Add refresh-in-progress guard keyed by credential, - Respect Retry-After header before retrying.
Sam (sdk): Also add quota-awareness: SDK should parse X-RI-Quota and automatically switch to conservative mode when remaining <= 3 (disable background prefetch + concurrency=1).
Noor (platform): We just added X-RI-Quota/X-RI-Reset to help clients — good to see it used. We can also expose X-RI-Scope in future for per-route quotas.
Quinn (oncall): Longer term: mobile clients should include idempotency keys for prefetch so retries don't double-count if they succeed twice.
Dev (mobile-sdk): Quick pseudocode for auth dedupe and resume debounce:
```
# on app resume
if time_since_last_resume < RESUME_DEBOUNCE: return
for req in queued_prefetch:
  if quota_remaining <= 3: break
  await send_with_backoff(req)

# auth refresh guard
if token_expired():
  if refresh_in_progress(cred_id):
    await wait_for_refresh(cred_id)
  else:
    await acquire_refresh_lock(cred_id)
    await refresh_token()
    release_refresh_lock(cred_id)
```
Riley: I flipped the sample mobile env to PREFETCH_ON_RESUME=false for trial cohorts and pushed a staging build.
deploy-bot: staging-mobile build succeeded @ 2026-04-09T08:12:05Z
Sam (sdk): I'll add parsing for X-RI-Quota and a conservative fallback in the mobile SDK. Also will make ResumeDebounce default to 2s on mobile. PR ETA 8h.
Noor (platform): I'll put a temporary edge smoothing window (5s) for UI-origin traffic for trial accounts while the SDK patch lands.
Quinn (oncall): Tasks: - Riley: confirm sample flip + staging smoke (done) - Dev: mobile SDK PR (auth coalesce + debounce) ETA 8h - Sam: add X-RI-Quota parsing + warning logs ETA 8h - Noor: edge smoothing toggle ETA 2h - Quinn: incident note + customer comms ETA 3h
Dev (mobile-sdk): Will add integration test covering background/resume + concurrent refresh + low quota 429s.
Sam (sdk): Also add a dev-mode warning log when X-RI-Quota low so integrators see it during onboarding.
Noor (platform): Consider documenting PREFETCH_ON_RESUME and RESUME_DEBOUNCE in onboarding guide and the sample app readme.
Riley: Thanks. If anyone sees leftover 429s after the rollout ping this thread and we can tighten the smoothing. :thumbsup:
